event:
I withdrew the finding, and the verdict was accepted.

The HMAC security-countermeasure testplan lists `tests: ["N/A"]` for the KEY.SIDELOAD item (`hw/ip/hmac/data/hmac_sec_cm_testplan.hjson:36`). Nothing in the repository ties that item to `keymgr_dpe_sideload_hmac_test`. The test is referenced only from the chip-level keymgr_dpe testplan and `chip_sim_cfg.hjson`, so the analysis inferred the link.

The finding's own description also says there is no concrete inconsistency between the plan and the test code. I did not read the test source itself, since the missing link was enough to withdraw.
